_comment: SDXL change-clothes workflow (ComfyUI API format). Same proven shape as replace_object.json. The mask is the CLOTHING sub-region only (person footprint minus head minus legs, derived in backend/comfy_clothes.py), so the face, hair, body pose, legs and background are outside the mask and stay fixed. The init image is the original context crop; SDXL regenerates only the masked clothing from the user's prompt at high denoise, anchored by the surrounding fixed latent so lighting/perspective/body shape carry over. The graph STRUCTURE lives here; comfy_clothes.py injects per-request VALUES by node id. Flow: load checkpoint -> encode prompts -> VAE-encode the crop -> restrict denoising to the clothing mask via SetLatentNoiseMask -> KSampler generates the new garment -> decode -> save.

inputs.text: different person, changed face, deformed, extra limbs, blurry, lowres, distorted, artifacts, seam, watermark, text
